feeds.title: Dr Christian Heim Blog
feeds.description: The website of Dr Christian Heim, award winning clinical psychiatrist and public speaker. His blogs and videos cover topics including the mental health crisis, neuroplasticity, the pleasure myth, and getting the right DOSE of brain chemicals to overcome 21st Century mental health issues.

feeds.title: Cultivate Calm Yoga Blog
feeds.description: The best place to start yoga is here. Beginner-friendly Vinyasa, Yin Yoga, and Meditation classes in East Brisbane. Here we share our thoughts and musings on all things yoga, meditation, emotional & mental health.

feeds.title: Mental Health Australia
feeds.description: Get the latest news and happenings from Mental Health Australia. Mental Health Australia is the peak, national non-government organization representing & promoting the interests of the Australian mental health sector, committed to achieving better mental health for all Australians.

feeds.title: Hoffman Process Blog
feeds.description: Hoffman Process Australia: a blog about mental health retreats, anxiety, depression, spiritual retreats, and more.

feeds.title: Molly Flexwell
feeds.description: When you Embark on a journey guided by Molly Flexwell, you'll explore the fusion of self-improvement and kindness into a harmonious environment. If you seek self-care practices tailored to your mental well-being, you've found the right place. Delve into the world of self-care for mental health and discover how to infuse it with the transformative power of kindness.

feeds.title: MHFA Blog
feeds.description: For more than 20 years, Mental Health First Aid Australia has been working to improve the mental health literacy of Australians. We do this through our early-intervention, skills-based Mental Health First Aid courses and by providing resources, including articles, written to inform and address the many myths and misunderstandings that exist when it comes to mental health. Covering a wide range of current and topical issues and taking a closer look at some of the common types of mental health problems, our articles are the perfect way to enhance your knowledge and understanding.

feeds.title: Australian & New Zealand Mental Health Association Blog
feeds.description: The Australian & New Zealand Mental Health Association blog features the latest news, information and topics in wellbeing. The Australian & New Zealand Mental Health Association is a non-government, not-for-profit association designed to unite mental health leaders since its inception in 1999. Through a selection of educational materials, annual events and continued development opportunities, we aim to support the personal and professional wellbeing of all mental health workers.

feeds.title: Peaceful Mind Psychology Blog
feeds.description: Peaceful Mind Psychology is a warm and professional private practice. We offer psychological support to adults, adolescents and their families, with expertise across a range of difficulties. We help our clients restore wellbeing in their lives and find peace within themselves and their relationships. Explore our Mental Health and well-being articles for expert insights and advice on mental health.

feeds.title: Workplace Mental Health Institute Blog
feeds.description: The Workplace Mental Health Institute (WMHI) provides HR, OHS, and management with the tools, evidence-based strategies, and education for all things mental health and wellbeing. Our mental health blog focuses on workplace & corporate culture, mental health strategies, policies & practices, mindfulness, wellbeing, stigma, anxiety, depression, stress, and all mental health problems.

feeds.title: The Mental Health Coach Blog
feeds.description: At The Mental Health Coach, we provide a range of services including Mental Health First Aid Courses, Mental Health First Aid Training, Counselling and Mental Health Coaching. We're experienced and qualified professionals focused on helping you navigate mental health in day-to-day life and at work. Get a better understanding of mental health, how to prevent mental health issues, mental health first aid and more!

feeds.title: Mind Connections Specialist Health Services Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about mental health through our specialist blogs from Mind Connections. Consultants at Mind Connections Specialist Health Services provide patient assessment, diagnosis, treatment and follow-up as individual clinicians. When it is necessary, Consultant Specialists collaborate with each other to optimize patient care. With their patient's permission, psychiatrists, psychologists, and medical specialists share clinical data. Collaborative care is designed to ensure that patients receive the best possible care when patients need it most.

feeds.title: Mental Health Queensland Blog
feeds.description: Our mental health Blog provides you with up-to-date information on common mental health disorders in Queensland, Australia. MentalHealthQLD.com.au is your online guide dedicated to supplying you with up-to-date information regarding mental health and mental illness in Queensland. The information contained on this site has been written by Clem Bonney, a mental health professional with 10+ years of experience treating mental health patients in Queensland.

feeds.title: Mind Medicine Australia Blog
feeds.description: Mind Medicine Australia is a charity that seeks to alleviate the suffering caused by mental illness in Australia through expanding the treatment options available. Our blog features some of the healing stories we have helped and encountered, news about events and seminars, tips for better mental health and more!

feeds.title: Prosper Health Collective Blog
feeds.description: Prosper Health Collective provides news, information and research via our blog to address concerns on mental health issues in children and adults. Prosper Health Collective is a Psychology practice that provides counseling, psychotherapy and assessment services for people experiencing difficulties in their lives. The practice offers clinical psychology services to children, adolescents and adults in a professional, caring and confidential manner.

feeds.title: Graeme Cowan Blog
feeds.description: A leader in mental health awareness, Graeme is one of Australia's foremost experts on how to help individuals and organizations thrive. His comprehensive blog shares tips, research and advice about resilience, mental wellness, leadership and organizational diversity and change.

feeds.title: Watersedge Counselling Blog » Mental Health Issues
feeds.description: Colleen Morris is a counsellor and family therapist based in Geelong, Victoria. On her blog she writes about a wide range of mental health issues including relationships, families, alcohol and drug addiction and personal growth.

feeds.title: Taylor & Francis Online » Mental Health
feeds.description: Read the latest issue and learn how to publish your work in Advances in Mental Health. Search and explore the millions of quality, peer-reviewed journal articles published under the Taylor & Francis and Routledge imprints.

feeds.title: Mentally Wellthy Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date on the latest developments in Mental Health in the Workplace. Mentally Wellthy partners with organizations to improve employee well-being, safety and performance. Working with Mentally Wellthy will help you to develop a culture where your people can show up at work as their best selves and contribute to your business. You will be equipping your team to thrive at work and to help their colleagues to thrive.

feeds.title: Craigontoast Mental Health Blog
feeds.description: I am Craig Mack, a social media and content strategist, speaker, lecturer, blogger, copywriter, model and ambassador for suicide prevention charity - r u ok?. As an Ambassador for R U OK? I share my own experiences of living with depression, and my attempts to 'check out early', to demystify some of the complexity of mental health, and what it means to support friends, family and those around us.

feeds.title: Visualising Mental Health Blog
feeds.description: Our Visualising Mental Health team writes about psychology, design and the interface between the two; with a focus on how both fields can make your daily life better. We also give updates about the VMH initiative here. Visualising Mental Health (VMH) is a collaboration between psychologist Dr. Gareth Furber and Match Studio and Communication Design lecturers at the University of South Australia.

feeds.title: Mental Strides Blog
feeds.description: Taking Mental Strides is the title of our blog series, but this is not your average mental health awareness blog. Think of Taking Mental Strides as a letter from a good friend, chatting about everyday life, the happenings of the world, and how these happenings can impact your thoughts and actions. Mental Strides helps organizations and communities across Western Australia build a culture that supports good mental health by providing professional, tailored mental health training and counseling.

feeds.title: Spanner In The Works » Mental Health
feeds.description: A Men's Health initiative by the Australian Men's Shed Association. Spanner in the Works provides you with a service and maintenance schedule for your body and some key health messages in a way that's easy to understand and achievable. It sets out things that you can do (or not do) to improve your health and your chances of a longer, happier life. Browse through our tips and advice for the better mental health of men, common mental health concerns of men around the world and more!

feeds.title: Mental Health Victoria News
feeds.description: Receive all the latest MHV news plus key headlines, events and opportunities from across the sector. Mental Health Victoria is the peak body for mental health and wellbeing in Victoria. We specialize in public policy, workforce development and training, and services that build individual, organizational and community capacity.

feeds.title: For Your Mind Boxes Blog
feeds.description: Specially created boxes designed for you and your loved ones with mental health concerns. We offer a range of Care Packages, Toolboxes, Gift Boxes and resources that promote grounding, distress tolerance, mindfulness, self-care and overall well-being. Discover more about our care packages, tips for mental health, survivors' stories and more!

feeds.title: PsychWatch Australia Blog
feeds.description: PsychWatch Australia is an informal collaboration of psychiatrists, psychologists, epidemiologists, policy researchers and mental health service consumers with lived experience. At least once a month we will publish a detailed referenced blog examining an important aspect of mental health policy and psychiatric practice in Australia. We will provide a professional and comprehensive mental health-related news service.

feeds.title: Bayside Psychotherapy Blog
feeds.description: At Bayside Psychotherapy, we strive to help you make the changes you want to make in your life and make those changes stick. Our counseling, hypnotherapy, psychology, and psychotherapy services target both the conscious and unconscious levels. Find out more about mental health, insights, statistics, tips for better mental health, healthy habits and more!

feeds.title: Mindsmith Wellness Blog
feeds.description: Our aim is for you to be able to experience trauma-informed, tailored counseling services that help you to re-adapt to your life after trauma. Check out our blog to know more about different trauma, our counseling tips, people's stories and more!

feeds.title: Mentally Well Workplaces Blog
feeds.description: At Mentally Well Workplaces, our team is equipped to provide you and your employees with a holistic range of services to support psychological well-being. From induction programs to web-based workshops and MHFA, there's sure to be an option that suits you. Our blog features tips and ways to maintain mental health in the office, work-life balance, communication and more!

feeds.title: Stride Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about mental health care, self-care practices and more. Stride is a not-for-profit organization delivering programs and services across the mental health care and disability sectors.

feeds.title: Ramsay Mental Health Blog
feeds.description: As the largest private provider of mental health care in Australia, Ramsay Mental Health is dedicated to making a real difference in the lives of those we treat. Explore our blog to find answers to all your questions regarding mental health and issues.

feeds.title: Blooming Minds Blog
feeds.description: Mental health blog with articles to foster positive mental health in the workplace, improve productivity and minimize psychological risk. For over 15 years, Blooming Minds has specialized in delivering mental health training. We see the issues and understand the challenges occurring in workplaces, large and small. We offer training that is easy to understand, and practical to implement into your workplace and life.

feeds.title: H-L Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Blog about NDIS and mental health therapy and disability for NDIS participants, people with mental illness, students & therapists. H-L Therapy offers therapy & counseling services for NDIS, Medicare and privately paying clients. Our focused psychological support services are provided face-to-face and online.

feeds.title: MyDr.com.au » Mental Health
feeds.description: Mental illness is very common in Australia. myDr. has put together these patient resources on depression, anxiety, PTSD, bipolar and other disorders. myDr is an Australian healthcare website dedicated to providing Australian consumers with the most comprehensive and relevant health information resource in Australia. myDr is a project of Tonic Digital Media Pty Ltd.
